mechanism: Bupropion inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing chlorpromazine metabolism inhibition and risk of toxicity; additive CNS depression and lowered seizure threshold; chlorpromazine may increase bupropion levels via CYP450 competition.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, reduce chlorpromazine dose, monitor for toxicity signs (EPS, sedation, seizures), and use with caution in patients with seizure history or low seizure threshold.
